text:
ops-bot: INCIDENT CREATED • ID INC-2026-04 • Service: inference-prod • Symptom: p99 latency > 2s (alert: inference.prod.latency.p95 > 1.2s for 5m).

Karim: oncall here, looking.

Mira: I'm watching traces — KV cache misses spiked on shard-3, lots of long-tail sequences.

Karim: Starting mitigation: scale up replicas on pool-a and enable fallback routing to small-quant for non-critical traffic.

Sam: will open quick canary for the fallback route now.

Anya: product asks about customer impact — any idea of percent affected?

Karim: preliminary metric shows ~3% of total requests experiencing high latency; mostly large batch jobs and a few web customers.

Lucas: tagged for handoff in 15m if still ongoing. I'm on standby.

Mira: scaling action executed: `kubectl scale --replicas=6 deployment/inference-pool-a` — watching pod readiness.

ops-bot: ACTION LOG — scale started by Mira (285s ago).

Karim: scaling looks good, new pods in Ready. Starting traffic shift to fallback for low-priority traffic.

Sam: applied fallback routing (canary):
```
route:
  - match: priority!=high
    model: small-quant-v2
  - else:
    model: base-chi
```

Anya: product approved a temporary 20% rate-limit on /v1/generate for job-type=batch to reduce pressure.

Karim: rate-limit applied. Monitoring for stabilization.

ops-bot: METRIC UPDATE — p95 back to 0.45s over last 5m. Suspending high-severity paging; continue watch for 30m.

Karim: good signal. Timeline notes: incident start 1905001234, mitigation ~1905001300, p95 normalized by ~1905001400.

Mira: root-cause notes — cache-manager evict rate spiked on shard-3 likely due to mem leak exposed by long sequences. Will capture heap and tracer dumps.

Lucas: for postmortem/retro we need a dashboard that surfaces per-shard KV hit-rate, per-model sequence-length distribution, fallback-route percentage, and per-customer error-rate.

Devon: +1. Also add golden-signal row: p50/p95/p99 latency, QPS, error rate, cache hit ratio in one compact panel.

Sam: alert tuning proposals: raise KV-miss alert window to 10m, add composite alert: p99 latency > 1s AND kv_miss_ratio > 0.15 to reduce noisy single-metric pages. Suppress low-volume customer churn alerts.

Anya: Can we build an incident-specific Grafana template that includes drilldowns to traces (Tempo), logs (Loki), and a query snippet for suspicious client ids? That would speed TTR.

Mira: I'll draft the panels and push a PR to `grafana-dashboards/inference-prod`. Plan: 6 panels on top row (golden signals), per-shard heatmap, seq-length histogram, fallback traffic %, per-customer error table, and a Logs/Trace shortcut panel.

Sam: I'll own the alert PR (increase window + composite alert). Devon — can you own the dashboard templating and PR review?

Devon: Yep, I'll template variables for shard, model, and customer. Also add drilldown links with `${trace_id}` variable.

Lucas: I'll update the runbook with the mitigation playbooks: scale, fallback routing snippet, and emergency rate-limit commands.

Karim: thanks everyone. Follow-ups will be tracked in #incidents-retro and the grafana-dashboards PR. Scheduling 30min retro tomorrow at 10:00 PT. :calendar: :coffee: 

ops-bot: INCIDENT CLOSED — Duration ~26m.
